blurb: Guests form teams of 2-8 people to solve puzzles, riddles, and physical feats in immersive themed rooms. Each room has a unique objective and offers an unlimited hint system. The experience lasts 60 minutes and is suitable for children ages 8 and up, with those under 12 accompanied by an adult.
